items.title: AI BASED INTERVIEW QUESTIONs GENERATOR
items.abstract: The AI Interview Questions Generator is a smart system designed to assist students and job seekers in preparing for technical interviews. The main objective of this project is to automatically generate relevant interview questions based on the topic provided by the user. With the increasing competition in the job market, interview preparation plays a crucial role in securing employment. This system helps users quickly access a variety of interview questions related to different technical subjects. The application uses Artificial Intelligence concepts and basic Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to analyze the input topic and generate appropriate interview questions. The system allows users to enter a specific topic such as programming languages, data structures, databases, or other technical areas. Based on the input, the system retrieves or generates a set of interview questions that can help users practice and improve their knowledge. The system is developed using Python for backend processing and web technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for the user interface. The backend processes the user input, identifies the relevant topic, and generates suitable interview questions from the question database. The generated questions are displayed in a structured format so that users can easily read and practice them. The AI Interview Questions Generator offers several advantages, including saving time in searching for interview questions, providing quick access to relevant questions, and helping users prepare effectively for technical interviews. The system also provides a simple and user-friendly interface that makes it accessible for students and beginners. In conclusion, this project demonstrates how Artificial Intelligence can be used to develop intelligent tools that support interview preparation. The system can be further enhanced in the future by integrating advanced AI models, adding more technical domains, and introducing features such as mock interviews and performance evaluation

items.title: AI BASED MEDICAL CHATBOT FOR PATIENT ASSISTANCE
items.abstract: The healthcare industry generates vast amounts of patient data daily, making manual patient support and query handling inefficient and time-consuming. This industry-oriented miniproject proposes an Artificial Intelligence (AI) based Medical Chatbot designed to assist patients by providing instant responses to medical queries, symptom analysis, and basic healthcare guidance. By leveraging Machine Learning (ML) algorithms and Natural Language Processing (NLP), the system can understand user inputs, interpret symptoms, and deliver accurate responses in real time. The proposed methodology includes data collection from medical datasets, preprocessing of textual inputs, and training NLP models for intent recognition and response generation. The chatbot utilizes deep learning models such as Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN) and Transformer-based architectures to improve conversational accuracy. Results indicate that the AI-driven chatbot significantly reduces response time and enhances patient engagement compared to traditional healthcare support systems. Traditional healthcare systems often face delays due to limited availability of medical staff and manual consultation processes. This project presents an AI-Based Medical Chatbot designed to provide 24/7 assistance, reducing workload on healthcare professionals. By analyzing patient queries, medical history, and symptom descriptions, the chatbot builds dynamic interaction models. Utilizing AI capabilities, the chatbot can suggest possible conditions, provide preventive measures, and recommend when to consult a doctor. Furthermore, integration with predictive analytics enables early identification of potential health risks. Ultimately, this system improves accessibility to healthcare, enhances patient satisfaction, and optimizes hospital resources, representing a shift from reactive healthcare services to proactive digital health assistance.

items.title: AI BASED MEDICAL REPORT ANALYZER
items.abstract: Medical reports often contain large amounts of textual information that can be difficult for patients to understand. Many medical terms, abbreviations, and diagnostic statements require professional interpretation, which makes it challenging for non-medical users to easily analyze their health reports. Manually reviewing and interpreting these reports can also take significant time for healthcare professionals. To address this challenge, the Medical Report Analyzer System is developed as an intelligent solution that uses Artificial Intelligence and Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to automatically analyze medical reports. The system extracts important information such as medical conditions, symptoms, test results, and key observations from uploaded reports. The application processes medical documents and identifies relevant medical terms using machine learning models and text analysis techniques. It then generates simplified explanations and structured summaries that help users better understand their medical reports. Additionally, the system can highlight abnormal findings and provide useful insights to assist users in interpreting their health information. This AI-powered solution improves accessibility and understanding of medical documents, reduces the effort required for manual interpretation, and helps patients make more informed decisions about their health. The Medical Report Analyzer can be useful for patients, healthcare professionals, and medical institutions by providing a faster and more efficient way to interpret medical reports.

items.title: AI BASED PERSONAL ADVERTISING SYSTEM
items.abstract: The digital advertising industry generates vast amounts of data daily, making manual campaign optimization inefficient and costly. This industry-oriented mini-project proposes an Artificial Intelligence (AI) based Advertising System designed to automate ad targeting, budget allocation, and predictive performance analysis. By leveraging Machine Learning (ML) algorithms such as Random Forest and Deep Neural Networks, the system analyzes consumer demographic data, browsing behavior, and historical engagement metrics to predict clickthrough rates (CTR) and optimize return on ad spend (ROAS). The proposed methodology includes a comprehensive data preprocessing pipeline, feature engineering, and real-time bidding simulation. Results indicate that the AI-driven approach significantly outperforms traditional rule-based advertising systems in both cost-efficiency and conversion rates. This project bridges the gap between theoretical machine learning models and practical, industry-standard digital marketing applications. Traditional advertising models often struggle with low engagement rates due to their generic, mass-targeting approach. This project presents an AI-Based Personal Advertising System designed to deliver highly customized marketing content tailored to individual users. By leveraging machine learning algorithms, predictive analytics, and data science techniques, the system continuously processes user data streams—including browsing behavior, engagement history, and preference indicators—to build dynamic profiles. Utilizing generative AI capabilities, the system can autonomously craft personalized ad creatives, adjusting imagery, video content, and copy to resonate with specific user tastes. Furthermore, the integration of demand forecasting models allows the system to determine the optimal timing and channel for ad delivery, maximizing conversion probabilities. Ultimately, this personalized framework significantly improves click-through rates, enhances user satisfaction by reducing irrelevant spam, and maximizes the return on investment (ROI) for advertisers, representing a critical shift from reactive mass marketing to proactive, individualized advertising.

items.title: AI BASED SKIN DISEASE DETECTION SYSTEM
items.abstract: Skin diseases are common health problems that require early detection and proper treatment. Traditional diagnosis by dermatologists can take time and may not always be accessible to everyone. This project proposes an AI Based Skin Disease Detection System that uses machine learning techniques to identify skin diseases from images. The system is developed using Python, TensorFlow, and Flask, and it uses a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model to analyze skin images and classify them into different categories such as acne, eczema, psoriasis, ringworm, and normal skin. The dataset used for training contains labeled images of different skin conditions. The trained model is integrated with a web application where users can upload a skin image. The system processes the image and predicts the possible disease automatically. This approach helps in providing quick and preliminary diagnosis, which can assist patients and healthcare professionals. The proposed system aims to improve early detection, increase accessibility, and support medical decision-making using artificial intelligence.

items.title: AI DEEPFAKE DETECTION
items.abstract: Deepfakes are artificially generated or manipulated images, videos, or audio created using advanced deep learning techniques. While these technologies can be used for entertainment and creative applications, they also pose serious threats such as misinformation, identity theft, and cybercrime. This project focuses on developing an AI-based deepfake detection system that can automatically identify manipulated media content. The system uses machine learning and deep learning techniques to analyze visual patterns, facial features, and inconsisten- -cies in videos or images. A dataset containing real and fake media samples is used to train the detection model. Image preprocessing, feature extraction, and classification algorithms are applied to improve detection accuracy. The model evaluates media files and predicts whether they are authentic or manipulated. Experimental results demonstrate that AI-based approaches can effectively detect deepfake content with high accuracy. This system can help social media platforms, news organizations, and cybersecurity agencies reduce the spread of fake digital content. Future improvements may include using advanced deep learning models and real-time detection systems to enhance reliability and performance. Deepfake detection has become an important area of research due to the rapid growth of artificial intelligence technologies used to create highly realistic fake media. Deepfake content can manipulate facial expressions, voice, and actions, making it difficult for humans to distinguish between real and fake information. This project aims to design an intelligent system that can detect deepfake images and videos using deep learning techniques such as Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). The system analyzes facial landmarks, texture patterns, and temporal inconsistencies present in manipulated media. By training the model on a dataset containing both real and fake samples, the system learns to recognize hidden patterns that indicate forgery. The proposed solution can assist in preventing the spread of misinformation, protecting digital identity, and improving online security. The results show that AI-based detection systems can play a vital role in maintaining the authenticity and trustworthiness of digital media.

This time-based evaluationavoids reliance on background subtraction methods, which are sensitive to lighting changes, shadows,and environmental disturbances. The system is designed to operate efficiently in crowded and dynamic environments such astransportation hubs, public spaces, and commercial areas. Learning-based techniques enable themodel to adapt to different datasets and operating conditions, improving detection reliability overtime. The approach also reduces false alerts by distinguishing routine activities from suspiciousbehaviour patterns. items.title: AI Enabled Virtual Try-On for E-Commerce
items.abstract: In today's digital environment, online fashion sales face return rates of 30 to 40 percent because customers cannot try products or things before buying. This paper introduces StyleGenie, an AI-enabled virtual try-on system that allows users to see photorealistic product images on their own photos The software uses Google Gemini generative multimodal AI model architecture for generating realistic images in more than nine categories of products including eyewear, shirts, hoodies, t-shirts, watches, women's tops, and traditional kurtas. A multi-model fallback strategy achieves an average try-on generation success rate of 92.9 percent. The platform offers AI-driven style analysis, which includes face shape detection, fit scoring, color harmony evaluation, and a stylist's recommendation. Built on React 18 with TypeScript and a secure Node.js/Express backend proxy, the system prioritizes user privacy and does not store images permanently. Client-side image processing reduces file size by over 70 percent. A pilot evaluation with 35 participants results in a System Usability Scale (SUS) score of 84.2, which is considered 'Excellent,' along with a 76 percent self-reported decrease in purchase uncertainty. Index Terms — Virtual Try-On, Generative AI, E-Commerce, Google Gemini, Fashion Technology, Computer Vision, React.js, Image Synthesis, Personalization, Style Analysis.

items.abstract: The AI Fake Review Detection System is designed to identify and filter fraudulent reviews posted on online platforms in order to maintain the authenticity and reliability of product feedback. In many e-commerce and service-based websites, fake reviews are often generated to manipulate product ratings and mislead customers, which can negatively impact user trust and decision-making. To address this issue, the proposed system utilizes Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning techniques to analyze review content, user behavior, and linguistic patterns to determine whether a review is genuine or fake. The system employs Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques such as sentiment analysis, keyword extraction, and pattern recognition to process and understand review text. Machine learning models are trained on labeled datasets containing both genuine and fake reviews, enabling the system to automatically classify incoming reviews with high accuracy. The application provides a userfriendly interface where reviews can be analyzed in real time, and suspicious or misleading reviews can be detected and flagged effectively. By implementing this system, online platforms can improve transparency, enhance customer trust, and ensure the credibility of product ratings and reviews. Ultimately, the AI Fake Review Detection System helps users make more informed purchasing decisions while promoting fairness and integrity in digital marketplaces.

items.title: AI in medical English teaching: Challenges and prospects
items.abstract: The article focuses on analyzing the opportunities and risks of integrating artificial intelligence (AI) technologies into the process of teaching Medical English. We emphasize the significant potential of AI as a tool for personalized learning, making it more interactive and professionally focused. However, empirical data suggest that without sustained student intrinsic motivation and competent pedagogical support, the use of AI becomes non-educational and destructive. This undermines the metacognitive basis of the educational process, leads to the formation of “illusory competence”, and hinders the development of critical thinking and self-regulation. As a solution, the article proposes the “A-C-C” methodological model (Analysis – Creativity – Control), designed to transform AI from a generator of ready-made answers into a catalyst for students’ analytical and creative activities. The model involves their thorough revision of the content, its creative application in practice-oriented scenarios (for example, taking a patient’s medical history or their consultation), and mandatory oral testing of student understanding of the educational material. The proposed model makes it possible to minimize non-educational use of AI and turn it into an efficient resource for building professional foreign language communicative competence of future healthcare providers.

items.abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) has revolutionized the field of robotics, enabling unprecedented advancements in autonomy, adaptability, and efficiency. Key AI techniques, including machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, and natural language processing, are examined in the context of robotics. The integration of AI with robotic systems has led to innovations in manufacturing, healthcare, autonomous vehicles, agriculture, and service industries. Additionally, the paper explores the challenges associated with AI-driven robotics, such as ethical concerns, safety considerations, and computational constraints. By analyzing recent developments and future trends, this study aims to highlight the transformative impact of AI-powered robotics and identify areas for further research and improvement.

items.title: AI PROMPT LIBRARY TOOL
items.abstract: Artificial Intelligence technologies have rapidly evolved in recent years and have become widely integrated into various fields such as education, business, healthcare, marketing, and software development. Many modern AI systems, including conversational agents, image generators, and coding assistants, rely heavily on prompts provided by users to generate accurate and meaningful responses. A prompt is essentially a structured instruction or query that guides the AI model in producing the desired output. The effectiveness of these AI systems largely depends on how well the prompts are written. However, many users face difficulties when interacting with AI systems because they are not familiar with the concept of prompt engineering. Writing effective prompts requires a certain level of understanding about how AI models interpret instructions. Poorly written prompts often lead to inaccurate or incomplete results, which can reduce the efficiency and usefulness of AI applications. As AI tools become more widely used, the need for a structured and accessible repository of high-quality prompts has become increasingly important. The AI Prompt Library Tool is designed to address this challenge by providing a centralized platform where users can discover, generate, store, and manage useful AI prompts. The system enables users to browse prompts across different categories such as content writing, programming, marketing, education, and productivity. In addition to browsing prompts, users can also generate new prompts based on specific topics using an automated prompt generation feature. This helps users quickly obtain structured prompts without needing advanced knowledge of prompt engineering. The application also allows users to add their own prompts to the library, making it a collaborative environment where useful prompts can be shared and reused by others. Additional functionalities such as prompt search, rating systems, and prompt sharing improve the usability of the platform and make it easier to find high-quality prompts. The system is implemented as a web-based application with a user-friendly interface and a backend framework responsible for managing user interactions, prompt storage, and dynamic content generation. By simplifying the process of prompt creation and discovery, the AI Prompt Library Tool helps users interact more effectively with AI systems and improves overall productivity. The platform serves as a valuable resource for students, developers, researchers, writers, and professionals who frequently work with AI tools. Ultimately, this project demonstrates how a well-organized prompt repository combined with intelligent prompt generation can significantly enhance the usability and efficiency of AI-driven applications

items.abstract: The AI Based Smart Energy Consumption and Optimization System is developed to predict and optimize energy usage using Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning techniques. With the growing demand for electricity in residential, commercial, and industrial sectors, efficient energy management has become essential to reduce energy wastage and minimize electricity costs. This project analyzes various parameters such as temperature, humidity, occupancy, and appliance usage to predict energy consumption. A machine learning model is trained using historical data to estimate the amount of energy required under different conditions. Based on the predicted results, the system provides intelligent recommendations to optimize energy usage and improve efficiency. The system is implemented using Python for the backend and machine learning model development**, while HTML and CSS are used to create a user-friendly web interface. The application allows users to input environmental and usage parameters, after which the system processes the data and predicts the expected energy consumption. It also provides suggestions for reducing unnecessary power usage.

items.abstract: The AI Social Media Post Generator is a mini project designed to automatically generate engaging and relevant social media posts using Artificial Intelligence. The system uses Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques to create posts based on user inputs such as topic, keywords, target audience, and platform (e.g., Instagram, Twitter, LinkedIn). The main objective of this project is to assist users, marketers, and content creators in generating creative, high-quality content quickly and efficiently. By leveraging pre-trained language models, the system analyzes the input context and produces meaningful captions, hashtags, and short promotional messages suitable for different social media platforms. The application typically consists of a user-friendly interface where users can enter their desired content topic or keywords. The backend AI model processes the input and generates multiple post suggestions, allowing users to select or modify the output before publishing. This helps reduce the time and effort required for content creation while maintaining creativity and relevance. The project can be implemented using technologies such as Python, Machine Learning, NLP libraries, and web frameworks like Flask or Django. It can also integrate APIs from AI services for improved text generation. Overall, the AI Social Media Post Generator improves productivity in digital marketing and social media management by automating the content generation process while ensuring engaging and contextually appropriate posts.

items.title: AI Workforce Accountability Framework
items.abstract: The AI Workforce Accountability Framework (AWAF) is a governance and risk-based model designed to bring structure, transparency, and responsibility to AI-driven workforce decisions. As organizations increasingly adopt artificial intelligence to optimize operations, workforce-related decisions are often made without adequate evaluation of human impact, long-term sustainability, or accountability. AWAF addresses this gap by introducing a structured approach that integrates governance principles into AI adoption. The framework is built on three core pillars:Human Impact Assessment, which evaluates the implications of AI-driven decisions on employees and roles;Reskilling and Transition Responsibility, which emphasizes the need for organizations to provide pathways for workforce adaptation rather than abrupt displacement; andAccountability and Transparency, which ensures that decisions are explainable, auditable, and aligned with governance standards. AWAF is designed to be applicable across industries and can serve as a foundational model for organizations seeking to implement responsible and sustainable AI strategies. The framework bridges the gap between technological innovation and human-centric governance, ensuring that AI adoption is not only efficient but also ethical and accountable.

items.title: AI-Assisted Dialysis Decision-Making: Assessing Agreement Between ChatGPT and Nephrologist in Initial Dialysis Indication and Prescription in Emergency and ICU Settings
items.abstract: BACKGROUND Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly explored as a clinical decision-support tool in nephrology; however, its real-world applicability for dialysis decision-making in emergency and intensive care unit (ICU) settings remains insufficiently studied. Hemodialysis initiation and prescription are complex, time-sensitive, and dynamic processes that require expert clinical judgment. MATERIAL AND METHODS This retrospective observational study evaluated agreement between AI-generated (ChatGPT) and nephrologist-made dialysis decisions in emergency and ICU settings. Adult patients undergoing first-time dialysis were included. Agreement was assessed for dialysis initiation, modality selection, and key prescription parameters. To ensure clinical relevance, continuous prescription variables were categorized into predefined ranges. Agreement was quantified using Gwet's AC1 coefficient and Cramer's V statistic. RESULTS Eighty-four patients were included. AI demonstrated 100% agreement with nephrologists regarding dialysis initiation. Overall agreement for dialysis modality selection was 92.9% (Cramer's V=0.87, P<0.001). Agreement for core dialysis prescription parameters - including blood flow rate, dialysate sodium, potassium, and calcium concentrations - was high across modalities (all P<0.001). Lower agreement was observed for ultrafiltration-related parameters, particularly ultrafiltration duration, reflecting the individualized and dynamic nature of volume management during dialysis. CONCLUSIONS AI-assisted decision support demonstrated high agreement with nephrologist decisions for initial dialysis initiation, modality selection, and core prescription parameters in emergency and ICU settings. Discrepancies were primarily confined to ultrafiltration-related decisions, underscoring the necessity of ongoing bedside clinical judgment. These findings support the role of AI as a decision-support tool rather than a replacement for clinician-led dialysis management.

items.title: AI-Augmented HRM Practices as Mediators of Sustainable Performance in the IT Industry: The Role of Digital Culture, Organizational Strategy, and Digital Leadership
items.abstract: The increased pace of Artificial Intelligence (AI) has reinvented human resource management (HRM) and made a difference in the approach organizations to gain, grow and sustain talents. This research study explores the relationship between Digital Culture (DC), Organizational Strategy (OS), and Digital Leadership (DL) on Sustainable Organizational Performance (SOP), with AI-Augmented HRM (AIHRM) as a moderating variable. Following a quantitative research approach, data were collected from employees of selected IT companies in Nepal using a questionnaire with predefined items. Furthermore, Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) was employed to evaluate both measurement and structural models for reliability, validity, and model fit. The findings reveal that DC, OS, and DL have significant and positive effect on AIHRM, collectively explaining 62.8% variance (R² = 0.628). Similarly, these predictors, along with AIHRM, account for 56.3% variance in SOP (R² = 0.563). Among all the predictors, OS has the strongest effect on SOP (β = 0.332, p < 0.001), which is followed by DC (β = 0.314, p < 0.001) and DL (β = 0.234, p < 0.001). AIHRM positively, though small, directly influences SOP (β = 0.122, p < 0.001) and is a good partial mediator between organizational variables and sustainability performances.
